First, note Asia/Shanghai is UTC+8 (standard time).  
US/Pacific is UTC-8 (standard time in 1968, no DST mentioned).  

Source: 22:00 (Oct 9) UTC-8  
Convert to UTC: 22:00 + 8 hours = 06:00 UTC (Oct 10).  
Convert to Shanghai: 06:00 + 8 hours = 14:00 (Oct 10).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 14:00 October 10
